text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: —Oh, how deeply I yearned for it.

text_block_list.name: Young Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
—Mother. May I really not go to the forest 
today either?

text_block_list.name: Zephyr's Mother
text_block_list.text:
...Right, your body must still ache a bit, 
doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Zephyr's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Once the pain subsides, go out and play 
again. I'm sure the fresh, clean air will 
help heal you.

text_block_list.name: Zephyr's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Still, you mustn't overdo it, okay? 
Otherwise, you'll ruin your health like 
this again."

text_block_list.name: Young Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, I understand.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WHOOSH—...!)

text_block_list.name: Young Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Ah—

text_block_list.name: Young Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(Caught in the wind, the leaves are... Ah, 
they're already flying that high up.)

text_block_list.name: Young Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ......Must be nice.

text_block_list.name: Young Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Tell me, Mr. Wind, how does it feel?

text_block_list.name: Young Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Endlessly, on and on... Just what kind of 
girl can run with the wind like that—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (――...WAAAAAAAHHH!!)

text_block_list.name: A Certain Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(Ah... what must that feel like? To be 
that strong, that sharp, that fast, so 
fast, faster than anyone else!)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (If only I could run... on and on...!!)

text_block_list.name: A Certain Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
If there's something you want to be, come 
with me.

text_block_list.name: A Certain Umamusume
text_block_list.text: To Tracen Academy. —To the Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yearning, and yearning, and yearning. And 
so, I—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the waiting room just before running in 
the Tenno Sho (Autumn). After a long, long 
meditation, Yamanin Zephyr snapped her 
eyes open and—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Then, she stared intently at me and spoke.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Trainer. Do you remember?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
When you told me... that “the wind is 
free.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Of course I remember. That was before the 
Debut Race..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Those were words meant to encourage 
Yamanin Zephyr.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —"The wind is free, isn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —"The wind is free, is it not?"

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I was just looking back on that moment 
just now.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Right, today—above all else, I decided to 
become freer than anyone.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Freely. Selfishly. Using everything 
blowing around me as fuel.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The gales of the sprint races. The fierce 
winds of the mile races.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
And I shall engulf all the gales of the 
middle-distance division to my heart's 
content.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I shall become the true, one-and-only…… 
—gale force wind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Pardon?
choice_data_list:
I'll be waiting at the finish line, 
waiting for the wind

I'll be waiting at the finish line, 
waiting for the wind, okay?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Please, bask in it to your heart's 
content.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The final race to an unprecedented 
three-division conquest. The Tenno Sho 
(Autumn) is finally about to begin—

text_block_list.name: Zephyr's Fans
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Here they come! The paddock for the 
Tenno Sho (Autumn) is starting!

text_block_list.name: Zephyr's Fans
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's put up the banner!! Do your 
best, Yamanin Zephyr—!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? You're—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...No, I see. That makes sense.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Let us witness it together. ...Where the 
wind shall lead.
